title: Terms of Use
intro: These terms cover your use of Fridge Pulse. Please read them, especially the food safety and subscription sections.

sections.heading: Agreement
paragraphs: By using Fridge Pulse you agree to these terms. On iPhone, Apple's Standard Licensed Application End User License Agreement (apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula) also applies, and these terms are in addition to it.

sections.heading: Food safety: please read
bullets: Expiry dates and shelf-life figures in Fridge Pulse are estimates. Dates read from a photo can be wrong, and the AI can misidentify food.
Always check the packaging, and use your own judgement: how food looks, smells and was stored. When in doubt, throw it out.

Calories, protein, carbs and fat are estimates for typical portions, from public nutrition data or, for AI meal ideas, from the AI. Real amounts depend on the product, the portion and how it is cooked. Check the label when the numbers matter to you.
Protein and calorie targets are general estimates for healthy adults, not advice for pregnancy, children, eating disorders or medical conditions. Ask a doctor or dietitian about what suits you.
Fridge Pulse is not professional food-safety, medical or dietary advice.
Meal ideas may not be free of allergens or suitable for every diet, even when you choose a diet setting. Check every ingredient yourself if you have an allergy or medical dietary need.

sections.heading: Free trial and subscription
bullets: Fridge Pulse is free to try for {{trialSpan}}. After that it costs {{price}} per month, or {{yearlyPrice}} per year on the yearly plan. The household plan costs {{householdMonthlyPrice}} per month or {{householdYearlyPrice}} per year. Taxes may apply and the price can differ by country.
The free trial starts when you confirm in the App Store or Google Play purchase sheet. Payment is charged to your Apple ID or Google Play account when the trial ends.
Each plan renews automatically at its price, every month or every year, unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.

The household plan also gives Fridge Pulse to everyone in the shared household of the person who pays, up to {{householdPeople}} people including them, for as long as the plan is active and they stay in the household. The people it covers do not pay and have no subscription of their own: if the plan ends, or they leave the household, they need their own plan to keep using the app.
You can switch plans in the app or in your Apple ID or Google Play subscription settings. Apple or Google decides when a change starts and any credit for the time left on your current plan.
Manage or cancel any time in your Apple ID or Google Play subscription settings. Deleting the app does not cancel your subscription.
Payments and refunds are handled by Apple or Google under their policies. We cannot issue refunds ourselves.

sections.heading: Your content
paragraphs: You own your photos and the items you track. You give us permission to process your photos and ingredient lists only to provide the features you use, as described in the Privacy Policy.
If you share a household, the people you give your invite code to can see and change the shared food and shopping lists. Share the code only with people you trust, and make a new code if it gets out.

sections.heading: Fair use
paragraphs: Please do not misuse the service: no reverse engineering, no automated scanning, and no attempts to overload or bypass limits. To keep costs and quality fair for everyone, scanning and meal ideas have daily limits.

sections.heading: Changes and availability
paragraphs: We may change, pause or stop features. If we change these terms we will update the date above; continuing to use the app means you accept the update.

To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for indirect or consequential losses, or for illness or loss arising from food decisions. Nothing here limits rights you have under the law that cannot be limited.
